_templateNotes: Copy this file to a new label file such as lying_leg_curl_001.json, then edit the paths, split, expectedReps, and reps.
Use issueIds from availableIssues. Use an empty issueIds array for a clean rep.
Files named _template.json or *.template.json are ignored by dataset:evaluate and dataset:optimize.
labelingGuidance: Count a rep when the leg-curl movement is clear, even if the side view or distal landmarks are too poor to judge form.
Use lying-leg-curl.side_view_uncertain when the rep is countable but side-view geometry is not reliable enough for form scoring.
Use lying-leg-curl.thigh_movement when the knee or thigh visibly lifts, slides, or swings instead of staying planted on the pad.
Note whether the ankle, heel, or foot index is the clearest lower-leg endpoint when the roller pad hides the ankle.
Use issueIds from availableIssues only for visible form faults; leave issueIds empty for clean reps.

reps.notes: Clean rep or describe the visible form issue.

notes: Draft label template. Copy to a real label file, review timings/issues, then set reviewStatus to reviewed.

availableIssues.feedbackMessage: Curl higher — bring your heels closer to your glutes.
Extend fully — straighten your legs at the bottom.
Keep your hips down — avoid lifting off the pad.
Keep your thighs down — only your lower legs should move.
Slow down the curl — control the contraction.
Control the descent — lower the weight slowly.
Pause briefly at the top — squeeze your hamstrings.
Move smoothly — avoid bouncing the weight.
Turn fully side-on so I can judge your leg curl.
